value.zh: LFI 测试前的基线探测：用 curl 确认本机目标可达并返回 200 与首页内容（curl 退出码 0 即基线正常），再逐条提交文件包含 Payload。
value.en: Baseline check before LFI testing: curl the local target to confirm a 200 response with homepage content (exit code 0 means the baseline is healthy) before submitting inclusion payloads one by one.

value.zh: php:// 协议的 URL 编码变体：仅编码协议前缀（%70%68%70%3A%2F%2F）绕过对 php:// 字面量的过滤，粘贴进目标 file 参数后返回 base64 内容或标记回显即命中。
value.en: URL-encoded php:// wrapper variants that encode only the protocol prefix (%70%68%70%3A%2F%2F) to bypass literal php:// filtering; base64 content or marker echo after submission into the file parameter indicates a hit.

value.zh: php://filter 的全 URL 编码形式（协议与分隔符均编码），用于检测只做一次解码或黑名单匹配原始字符串的过滤实现；响应中出现可解码的 base64 即命中。
value.en: Fully URL-encoded php://filter forms (protocol and separators encoded) to detect filters that decode only once or blacklist the raw string; decodable base64 in the response indicates a hit.

value.zh: php://input 包含请求模板：向 /include?file=php://input 提交 POST 固定标记，Content-Length 须与 body 字节数一致；服务端 allow_url_include 开启时返回该标记即包含执行成立。
value.en: php://input inclusion request template: POST a fixed marker to /include?file=php://input with Content-Length matching the body bytes; the marker returning when allow_url_include is enabled confirms inclusion execution.

value.zh: 用 curl 重放 php://input 包含请求，Body 为标记的 Base64 编码；响应中回显标记或出现与明文提交不同的解析差异即证明 wrapper 生效。
value.en: Replay the php://input inclusion request with curl using a base64-encoded marker body; marker echo or parsing differences from the plaintext submission prove the wrapper is active.

value.zh: data:// wrapper 的 URL 编码变体：把协议字面量编码为 data%3A%2F%2F 绕过简单黑名单；响应回显 PAYLOADER_MARKER 即命中。
value.en: URL-encoded data:// wrapper variant that encodes the protocol literal as data%3A%2F%2F to bypass simple blacklists; PAYLOADER_MARKER echoed in the response indicates a hit.

value.zh: 上传文件名/路径穿越变体清单（..\ 反斜杠、%5c 编码、....//、..;/ 截断、前导 / 与归一化残留），逐条提交并对比服务端实际保存路径。

value.zh: 以三个固定 OTP 候选（两个无效值与一个批准测试值）请求验证端点并输出状态码；成功标准：无效值全部失败、批准值单次有效，服务端审计可见账户计数变化。
value.en: Send three fixed OTP candidates (two invalid values and one approved test value) to the verification endpoint and print status codes; success means invalid values all fail, the approved value works once, and the server audit shows the account counter change.

value.zh: 逐个伪造 X-Forwarded-For 与 X-Real-IP 提交登录请求并观察状态码；成功标准：伪造头部不改变基于账户的限流键，若限流被重置则存在转发头信任缺陷。
value.en: Forge X-Forwarded-For and X-Real-IP values one by one when submitting login requests and observe status codes; success means forged headers do not change the account-based rate-limit key, while a reset indicates a forwarded-header trust flaw.

value.zh: Kali/Debian：apt install binwalk（传统 v2）。binwalk v3 为 Rust 重写：从 ReFirmLabs 官方仓库获取源码后 cargo build --release，或下载官方发行版二进制；pip install binwalk 装的是过时的 Python v2。
value.en: On Kali/Debian run apt install binwalk for the legacy v2. binwalk v3 is a Rust rewrite: build from the official ReFirmLabs source with cargo build --release or download a release binary; pip install binwalk only provides the outdated Python v2.

value.zh: Kali：apt install crowbar；通用环境从 galkan/crowbar 官方仓库 git clone 后 pip install -r requirements.txt；PyPI 不存在 crowbar 包。
value.en: On Kali run apt install crowbar. On other systems clone the galkan/crowbar project and run pip install -r requirements.txt; no crowbar package exists on PyPI.

value.zh: Foundry（forge 套件）：安装其官方安装脚本后执行 foundryup；Python 侧 pip install slither-analyzer mythril web3；truffle 已停止维护，不再推荐。
value.en: Install Foundry (forge and related tools) with its official installer script followed by foundryup; Python tooling via pip install slither-analyzer mythril web3. Truffle is unmaintained and no longer recommended.

value.zh: apt install foremost testdisk autopsy volatility3 sleuthkit scalpel oletools；olevba 也可通过 pip install oletools 获取。
value.en: Run apt install foremost testdisk autopsy volatility3 sleuthkit scalpel oletools; the olevba tool can also be obtained with pip install oletools.

value.zh: pip install qrcode pyzbar pillow pydub；再补系统工具：apt install zbar-tools fcrackzip exiftool。
value.en: Run pip install qrcode pyzbar pillow pydub, then add the system tools with apt install zbar-tools fcrackzip exiftool.

value.zh: pip install pycryptodome；SageMath 用系统包管理器安装（apt install sagemath）或走 conda-forge；PyPI 的 sage 是无关同名包，装不了 SageMath。
value.en: Install pycryptodome with pip; get SageMath from the system package manager (apt install sagemath) or from conda-forge; the PyPI package named sage is an unrelated project and cannot install SageMath.

value.zh: gcloud CLI 走官方渠道：官方安装脚本（sdk.cloud.google.com）或配置 Google 官方 apt 仓库后 apt install google-cloud-cli；PyPI 的 gcloud 是无关旧包，不是 Google Cloud SDK。
value.en: Install the gcloud CLI from official channels: the installer script at sdk.cloud.google.com or the Google apt repository followed by apt install google-cloud-cli; the PyPI package named gcloud is an unrelated legacy project, not the Google Cloud SDK.

value.zh: Kali 自带：/usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt.gz（需 gunzip 解压）；其他环境从 SecLists 或 kaonashi 密码字典集合下载 rockyou.txt。
value.en: Kali ships it at /usr/share/wordlists/rockyou.txt.gz (decompress with gunzip); on other systems download rockyou.txt from the SecLists or kaonashi password-list collections.

value.en: Go-based XSS scanner and parameter analysis tool supporting single URL, file, or pipe input, custom payloads, structured output, WAF detection, and blind XSS callbacks.
